, Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed the comparison criterion to “age at film release” instead of answering the question about which film has the younger director by birth year. Despite earlier establishing that Amos Kollek (born 1947) is younger than A. B. Raj (born 1925/1929), the Planner concluded Kalippava based on ages at release, leading to the wrong final answer.
